msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): Boutique campaign still life of a stainless steel American-style side-by-side fridge with a water dispenser, no logos, in a bright modern kitchen from the reference. The product sits in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm natural light, soft textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a stainless steel American-style side-by-side fridge with a water and ice dispenser, no logos from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EDF0F3) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a white front-loading washing machine with a dark round door, no logos from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EDF0F3) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a stainless steel two-door combi fridge freezer, no logos from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EDF0F3) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a white freestanding dishwasher, no logos from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EDF0F3) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail.
